active_evidence.anchor: Table 2: crop straw N released within season, 45.11–54.04 percent for seven crops
active_evidence.published_quantity: In-season N release fraction, not a daily rate constant
active_evidence.adaptation: Select a 50 percent release fraction over a declared 90-day reference interval, k=ln(2)/90 per day, for the mixed fresh/active pool. 90 days is a research timescale, not the duration reported for every Table 2 experiment.
active_evidence.identity_warning: Fresh residue N release is not identical to net SON mineralization. Applying this effective rate to initial active SON and new organic inputs is a structural research assumption; not a PRB field calibration.

protected_evidence.published_quantity: SOM decomposition turnover in a carbon-nitrogen cascade with environmental modifiers
protected_evidence.adaptation: Use this timescale as an effective direct SON nitrogen release reference; no claim of equivalent carbon-nitrogen cascade.
protected_evidence.version_warning: Pinned document content describes CLM6 despite legacy CLM50 filename; do not cite this as CLM5 default.

temperature_candidate_not_enabled.source_anchor: Same pinned CTSM decomposition technical note, environmental temperature scalar
temperature_candidate_not_enabled.limitation: Soil temperature alone does not reproduce CTSM moisture/oxygen/depth controls.

rejected_direct_transfer.reason: SWAT humic mineralization factor with environmental and inter-pool pathways is not directly a fresh residue daily rate. Direct use for all LAND1 fresh inputs would have a roughly 9.1-year e-fold time, conflicting with the intended fresh/active semantics. Retained as external evidence, not adopted as primary mixed-pool default.
